UNDERTOW v0.5.1 - tester checklist
==================================

Thanks for testing! Tick the boxes as you go ([x]) and write a few words
next to anything that feels off. You don't have to do everything: even
half of this list helps a lot. Send this file back (or just your notes)
on Discord or WhatsApp.

Controls in short: lanes 1 2 3 4, Esc = pause / back, Enter = confirm,
F11 = fullscreen / window; gamepad: D-pad/stick move, A confirm, B back,
Start pause. The README has the full list.


1. SETUP
--------
[ ] Unzip the WHOLE folder somewhere (e.g. your Desktop). Keep the .exe and
    the .pck file together.
[ ] Double-click undertow-debug.exe.
[ ] If Windows says "Windows protected your PC": click "More info", then
    "Run anyway" (the game isn't signed, that's expected).
[ ] Do the CALIBRATE SONAR wizard first (it opens by itself on first launch,
    or Main menu > Calibrate Sonar). Wired headphones/speakers if you can.
    My audio offset was: ______ ms
[ ] The game opened without errors or a crash.


2. MAIN MENU
------------
[ ] The background moves (abyss, light, drifting snow, a submarine).
[ ] Menu music plays quietly.
[ ] Moving up/down through the items: each one shows a short description
    and you hear a soft blip.
[ ] The LAST DIVE card shows your last song and best depth (after your
    first dive).


3. SONG SELECT (Main menu > Start Dive)
---------------------------------------
[ ] Every song has a cover picture (album art or a generated one).
[ ] The difficulty tiles (Left / Right) show a note count and a 1-5
    intensity meter.
[ ] Waiting on a song for half a second plays a preview, and the
    visualizer moves with the music.
[ ] Typing filters the list by title or artist; Esc clears it.
[ ] F2 changes the sort order.


4. PLAY THE 3 SONGS
-------------------
Play each song once on Expert and once on Easy (Enter starts the dive).

                         Expert   Easy
  HRT                     [ ]     [ ]
  Sea Shanty 2            [ ]     [ ]
  INVISIBLE               [ ]     [ ]

For each one:
[ ] Are the notes in sync with the music? (on the beat / early / late?)
[ ] Does the timing feel fair? (PERFECT / GOOD / MISS)
[ ] Do the hit windows feel fair now (not too easy, not too strict)?
    (v0.5.1 made them wider.)
[ ] Can you tell the 4 note shapes apart quickly?
[ ] Hit explosions, the multiplier ring and the hull arc react to your
    play; section names show up at the top during the song.
Write down anything odd as: song, difficulty, time (e.g. "HRT, Easy, 1:20").
[ ] Settings > Display > Background: play one song on Calm and one on
    Living. Which do you prefer, and what bothers you in the other?
    I prefer: Calm / Living   ____________________________________


5. RESULTS SCREEN
-----------------
[ ] The grade (S A B C D), accuracy %, depth and max combo look right.
[ ] The early/late histogram shows up (does it match how you felt?).
[ ] "Retry Dive" restarts the song.
[ ] "Song Select" goes back to the song list.
[ ] "Back to Menu" goes to the main menu.


6. PAUSE AND SETTINGS
---------------------
During a dive press Esc:
[ ] The pause menu appears and the song stops.
[ ] Resume Dive continues from the same place.
[ ] Restart Dive asks before restarting.
Open Settings (from the pause menu or the main menu):
[ ] Display > Low effects: the background gets simpler, notes stay bright.
[ ] Gameplay > Reduce motion: less shaking and movement.
[ ] Audio > Master, Music and SFX sliders change the volume (SFX = the menu
    blips). Menu music can be turned off.
[ ] Gameplay > Scroll speed: try a slow and a fast speed. Still readable?
[ ] Controls: rebind a lane key, play a bit, then Reset Controls.
[ ] With a controller: rebind a lane in the GAMEPAD column, play a bit,
    then Reset Controls.


6b. CONTROLLER IN MENUS (if you have a gamepad)
-----------------------------------------------
[ ] With only a controller: start the game, pick a song, pause, open
    Settings, change something, go back, and return to the main menu.
    Note any screen where a button did nothing.
[ ] Also with only the controller: the results screen buttons, and
    Settings > Calibration > Re-run Calibration and back.
    My controller: Xbox / PlayStation / other ______________


7. CALIBRATION AND PRACTICE
---------------------------
[ ] Settings > Calibration > Re-run Calibration works and saves a value.
[ ] Main menu > Practice Dive (No-Fail): play badly on purpose. You
    shouldn't sink, and the results say the dive was not recorded.
[ ] Settings > Gameplay > No-Fail does the same for normal dives.


8. PERFORMANCE
--------------
[ ] Did the game run smoothly? Any stutter, freeze or slow moment?
    (When? Which song / screen?)
[ ] If it stuttered: does Low effects fix it?
My PC: graphics card (GPU) __________________  screen Hz ______


9. THE BIG QUESTIONS
--------------------
Does it look like a finished game now?
  ______________________________________________________________
Is anything hard to read during play?
  ______________________________________________________________
Anything that feels too busy?
  ______________________________________________________________
Anything else (confusing, ugly, annoying, or something you liked)?
  ______________________________________________________________


HOW TO REPORT A BUG
-------------------
Please send:
  - which screen (menu, song select, during a song, results, pause, settings)
  - the song and difficulty, and roughly when (e.g. "INVISIBLE, Expert, 2:05")
  - what happened, and what you expected
  - a screenshot if you can (Win + Shift + S, or the Print Screen key)
  - your PC: Windows version, graphics card, and your headphones/speakers
    (wired / Bluetooth / USB)
If the game crashed: start undertow-debug.console.exe instead, do the same
thing again, and screenshot the black text window. It shows the error.

Thanks for diving!
